Discount decision condition: the retained implementations already select distinct primary displayed values from the same calculation. At 100 and 20%, private.remaining.117@1 selects discount amount 20; private.remaining.118@1 selects remaining price 80; both retain both outputs. The public v1 packet contains only the discount amount. For shared-route approval, confirm each ID's canonical requirements, qualify the existing route's ability to present both values from the original arithmetic, and preserve exact replay of existing v1 packets without remapping the sale-price route. Any public-facing or shared implementation change belongs with Worker 3 after that decision.

**W1 — W1-WEATHER → W3-INTEGRATION | HANDOFF_PENDING_ACCEPTANCE**

Drive archive upload was blocked by approval review pending exact destination confirmation.

Worker 3 owns adoption of the proposed shared admin page and snapshot dispatch hunks and genuine authenticated integration acceptance: history, persisted scenarios/recovery, account isolation, plan enforcement and export readbacks. The `@1` engine blob was unchanged. Wind chill needs source-domain confirmation at 4.8 km/h and 10 °C and clarification of observation conventions. Dew point needs provenance for Magnus constants 17.625 and 243.04, liquid-water applicability and low-temperature/low-RH precision assessment. Canonical mapping of #490/#538 and #492/#540 remains open because each pair shares an engine tuple. No additional implementation was made for #538 or #540.

W1 continues W1-PUBLIC. Release hold active.
